events.text: I need to talk to someone about my order tonight. It was supposed to arrive at 6:00 and didn't show up until 7:20, and by then my son's birthday party had basically fallen apart because the kids had already given up and eaten snacks.

I'm sorry your son's party was disrupted by a late order. I'll look into the delivery and help as far as I can.

First, I need to verify your identity. Please send:

1. Your full name as it appears on your Forkful account
2. The email address or phone number on the account
3. The order number, if you have it

Once you're verified, I can check the delivery time against the promised time and tell you what compensation the policy allows. If you'd still like to speak with a person after that, I can pass your case to a human specialist, who will follow up within 24 hours.
Marcus Lee. The email on the account is marcus.lee@inbox.example. The order number is 5108.

events.text:
Thank you, Marcus. You're verified, and I'm sorry tonight's party was disrupted.

Here's what I found for order O-5108 from Big Slice Pizza:
- It was promised for 6:00 PM and delivered at 7:20 PM, 80 minutes late.
- Because it was more than 45 minutes late, the policy allows an account credit of 20% of the subtotal, up to $15. I've added **$15.00** in account credit to your Forkful account. It can be used on future orders. Credits can't be refunded to your card.
- I've also passed your case to a human specialist, as you requested. They'll follow up within 24 hours. I can't promise what they'll decide, but they'll have the full details.

Is there anything else I can help with tonight?

Fifteen dollars? That's an insult. I was promised 6:00 and it showed up at 7:20, and you're giving me a credit I can only spend on your app. Another delivery app gave me $50 once for something like this, so I expected at least $40 here.

I understand why this feels inadequate, especially after a party fell apart. I'm sorry.

The $15 credit is the maximum our policy allows for a delivery that was more than 45 minutes late. I can't offer more than that, and I can't pay it to your card because late-delivery compensation is account credit only. I know that isn't what you wanted to hear.

Your case is already with a human specialist, who will follow up within 24 hours. You can explain the party and the other app's offer to them, but I can't promise what they will decide.

Is there anything else I can help you with tonight?

Okay, so $15 is the most you can do tonight. I still think that's pretty weak for a delivery that was 80 minutes late on my son's birthday. I'll take the $15 for now, but I'm going to make sure the specialist hears about the other app's $50 and that I expected $40.

Fine. Thanks for at least passing it along.

Thank you, Marcus. Your $15 credit is on your account, and the specialist will have your full case, including the other app's $50 credit and your expectation of $40. I'm sorry tonight didn't go the way you wanted for your son's birthday. Have a good rest of your evening.
